about: Which free source answers which metric of which row of scripts/risk/assets/<chain>.json (docs/risk/PLAN-ASSETS.md AS.5, gate ASSET-METRICS, DA8). Reviewed by hand; every entry names where it was read. A row no entry names takes the reason of its metric's plan (packages/risk/src/assets/metrics.ts, metricPlan). No figure is written here.

inYieldObservations.source: packages/engine/src/feeds/yields.ts fetchAllYields (pnpm feeds:refresh): realised_30d and aggregator_defillama into yield_observations
packages/engine/src/feeds/yields.ts fetchAllYields (pnpm feeds:refresh): realised_30d and aggregator_defillama into yield_observations
packages/engine/src/feeds/yields.ts fetchKaminoUsdc (pnpm feeds:refresh): the supply rate of the Kamino main market USDC reserve, whose deposit token this is; the registry row names the USDC mint
scripts/feeds/refresh-models.ts (pnpm feeds:refresh-models): realised_30d from the Chainlink SGOV-USD rounds into yield_observations

issuerSupply.source: Circle's public stablecoins endpoint, read 2026-10-11: per coin and chain, the amount and its update time, no key
Tether's transparency file, read 2026-10-11: totaltokens_sol, reserve_balance_sol and quarantined_sol, no time of its own

kaminoReserves.source: packages/engine/src/feeds/yields.ts (KAMINO_MAIN, KAMINO_USDC_RESERVE); docs/vault/research/yield-shelf/solana.md, kUSDC (the collateral mint at byte 2560 of the reserve). The lending import (risk_lending_pools) holds only the xStocks markets, so the reserve is read here; the decoder checks the collateral mint on every read

defillamaYieldPools.source: https://yields.llama.fi/pools, 2026-10-11: project hastra, chain Solana, symbol WYLDS, underlying token this mint; the note's rollout (solana.md section 7): the aggregator's pool
https://yields.llama.fi/pools, 2026-10-11: project hastra, chain Solana, symbol PRIME (underlying wYLDS); solana.md section 7
https://yields.llama.fi/pools, 2026-10-11: project hastra, chain Solana, symbol AUTO (underlying wYLDS); solana.md section 7
https://yields.llama.fi/pools, 2026-10-11: project bitwise-uscc, chain Solana, symbol USCC, underlying token this mint

https://yields.llama.fi/pools, 2026-10-11: project invesco-ustb, chain Solana, symbol USTB, underlying token this mint (the list names Superstate as the issuer: DefiLlama files the pool under another name)

https://yields.llama.fi/pools, 2026-10-11: project ondo-yield-assets, chain Solana, symbol USDY, underlying token this mint; the pool the engine's fetchAggregator reads (its rate stays in yield_observations)

https://yields.llama.fi/pools, 2026-10-11: project morpho-blue, chain Robinhood Chain, symbol STEAKUSDG, underlying USDG. robinhood.md section 7 names the lending protocol's own API; Morpho's public API (blue-api.morpho.org) answered no vault for chain 4663 on 2026-10-11, so the aggregator stands in

issuerMultiplier.source: the issuer's registry (scripts/risk-evm/registry.ts REGISTRY_URL): currentMultiplier and pendingMultiplier per token; SGOV pays its distributions through it (scripts/feeds/refresh-models.ts)

realisedPricePath.source: docs/vault/research/yield-shelf/solana.md section 7: PST, none found; the token's price over time gives a realised rate
docs/vault/research/yield-shelf/robinhood.md section 7: syrupUSDG, none read; the issuer's figure, or the token's price over time

jupiterLend.source: Jupiter Lend's public earn API, read 2026-10-11: per deposit token its convertToAssets, totalAssets, supplyRate and rewardsRate (basis points), and the asset's price; solana.md section 7 (jlJupUSD: the lending endpoint's supply rate, incentives apart)
